eyebrow: NoSQL, Document & Graph Databases · Chapter Eleven
subtitle: Lesson 63 · Querying with Cypher

code:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:WORKS_AT]->(c:Company)
WITH c, count(p) AS employeeCount
WHERE employeeCount > 10
RETURN c.name, employeeCount
caption: No HAVING in Cypher — WITH is how you filter on an aggregate.

code:
MATCH (p:Person)
CALL {
  WITH p
  MATCH (p)-[:WORKS_AT]->(c:Company)
  RETURN count(c) AS companyCount
}
RETURN p.name, companyCount
caption: WITH p imports the outer row — like a correlated subquery.

code:
MATCH (p:Person)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:WORKS_AT]->(c:Company)
RETURN p.name, c.name
caption: Keeps every Person, filling null when no company matches.
